sample_identity: A/B are local teaching-model labels, not one electrolyte across unlike techniques; SIM IDs are invented records, never citations.
test_conditions: Illustrative Li||Cu repeated plating/stripping; 1 mA cm−2; 1 mAh cm−2 plated; 1 V stripping cutoff; 25 °C.
creator: BatteryReviewForge original code

review.science: Declared model equations/units/linked-file relations have scoped automated tests; no experimental certification.
review.display: Actual line/frame/alignment checks only; independent visual and author review remain pending.

curve_style_check: pass: actual rendered Line2D artists are solid and have no markers
data_frame_check: pass: actual data axes show top/right/bottom/left spines

scientific_basis.parameter_origin: self-chosen teaching values; never paper measurements
scientific_basis.validation_scope: Declared teaching model; no experimental/material certification
assumptions: Chosen recoverable-charge fractions; excess Li counterelectrode so CE is not full-cell retention.
Negative applied current is plating; positive is stripping; cutoff is reached at the CE-derived endpoint.
Voltage is a display relation, not a fitted nucleation, SEI or depletion mechanism.

references.title: Understanding and applying coulombic efficiency in lithium metal batteries
references.supports: CE charge accounting and protocol/cell-configuration boundaries; not the source of demo numbers.

limitations: Cannot infer dead Li versus electrolyte consumption, dendrites, full-cell life or a material benefit.
